notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked; simulated R0; model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 and unreviewed; no hardware run and no MHS-Device level claimed). The upstream stack (Isaac Sim 2.3.2.post1, Isaac Lab, torch 2.7.0, Python 3.11 and an NVIDIA GPU, README.md:28-32 and :75) was never started or installed here. The package lists only the package fake backend. The registered environment cannot be created by GymnasiumDriver's gym.make(env_id) path alone: training/scripts/play.py:63-64 launches AppLauncher first and :110 passes a prebuilt Go2LocoEnvCfg as cfg; the upstream environment is also vectorized over num_envs (4096 by default, go2_loco_env_cfg.py:185), while the MHS Gymnasium bridge drives one environment. The fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in: it keeps the 12-value action width (go2_loco_env_cfg.py:178), the 845-value policy width (go2_loco_env_cfg.py:248-262) and the 2 x 25 x 60 depth shape (go2_loco_env_cfg.py:249 and sensor/lidar_pattern.py:86-88), but its values are placeholders. It has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor, terrain, noise, reward or termination model; the reductions are in fidelity.gaps. NOT COVERED: the real Isaac Sim policy and depth arrays are only shapes here; they carry no physically meaningful values. Warnings are explained: G1.CLONE_NOTE reports the pre-existing case-insensitive pair deployment/unitree_mujoco/unitree_robots/go2w/assets/terrain.STL and terrain.stl, which was present before the first gate run and was not written by this package. G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is expected (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset). G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close is expected because Go2LocoEnv inherits them from DirectRLEnv outside the clone. G8.NO_UNIT x4 covers the bridge-derived ticks, the two seed inputs and action.values (the simulation action has no physical unit). G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is truthful: no finite action bound can be sourced because the Box bounds belong to Isaac Lab's DirectRLEnv outside the clone, so the suite awards CL2 while every other CL3 test passed. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
